Corrosion.o: Can poison or badly poison targets regardless of their type.
Corrosion.s: Can poison or badly poison targets regardless of their type, and Poison-type moves can hit Steel types.

Defeatist.o: Halves Attack and Special Attack at half HP or less.
Defeatist.s: Halves Attack and Special Attack at 1/3 HP or less.

Flare Boost.o: Boosts the power of special attacks by 50% while burned.
Flare Boost.s: Boosts the power of special attacks by 50% while burned, and prevents burn damage.

Flower Gift.o: In sun, Cherrim changes to Sunshine Form and boosts its own and its allies' Attack and Special Defense by 50%.
Flower Gift.s: In sun, Cherrim changes to Sunshine Form and boosts its own and its allies' Attack and Special Defense by 50%.

Ice Body.o: Restores 1/16 of maximum HP at the end of each turn in snow.
Ice Body.s: Restores 1/16 of maximum HP at the end of each turn in snow. Attackers that make contact have a 30% chance of frostbite.

Illuminate.o: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering its accuracy, and ignores the target's evasion boosts.

Illusion.o: Enters disguised as the last unfainted Pokemon in the party until hit by a damaging move.
Illusion.s: Enters disguised as the last unfainted Pokemon in the party until hit by a damaging move, and deals 30% more damage while disguised. The AI is not fooled by the disguise.

Iron Fist.o: Boosts the power of punching moves by 20%.
Iron Fist.s: Boosts the power of punching moves by 30%.

Liquid Voice.o: Turns sound-based moves into Water-type moves.
Liquid Voice.s: Turns sound-based moves into Water-type moves and boosts their power by 20%.

Mountaineer.o: Blocks Stealth Rock damage, and Rock-type attacks on the turn it enters battle.
Mountaineer.s: Blocks Rock-type attacks and Stealth Rock damage.

Protean.o: Changes its type to match the move it is about to use, once each time it enters battle.
Protean.s: Changes its type to match the move it is about to use, before every move.

Quick Feet.o: Boosts Speed by 50% while it has a status condition, and ignores the Speed drop from paralysis.
Quick Feet.s: Doubles Speed while it has a status condition, and ignores the Speed drop from paralysis.

Shield Dust.o: Blocks the added effects of moves that hit it.
Shield Dust.s: Blocks the added effects of moves that hit it, and damage from entry hazards.

Toxic Boost.o: Boosts the power of physical attacks by 50% while poisoned.
Toxic Boost.s: Boosts the power of physical attacks by 50% while poisoned, and prevents poison damage.

Water Compaction.o: Raises Defense by two stages when hit by a damaging Water-type move.
Water Compaction.s: Halves damage from Water-type moves and raises Defense by two stages when hit by one.
